item_short_desc: Stay warm and protected with Rothco’s Cold Weather Gloves. These gloves are designed to shield your hands from harsh elements, featuring a windproof nylon shell and Thermoblock insulation for exceptional warmth. The neoprene knuckle panel enhances flexibility and mobility, ensuring comfort during prolonged wear. Leather embossing on the palms and fingers provides a superior grip, making these gloves ideal for a variety of outdoor activities. The tricot lining adds an extra layer of comfort, while the secure fit helps retain heat.
